conclusion: The archive difference is caused by different train masks: the old buffer followed measured min/max segment IDs rather than physical block bounds. Test keys, S1A and preprocessing are identical; old-mask refit matches the archive. The current physical protocol is retained for 200/50 and 500/100.
current_rule: physical blocks: center=(start+end)/2, block=floor(center/100); buffer 20 m around block bounds; train excludes target rows in block+buffer
old_rule: test = segment_id // 10; buffer = min/max measured segment_id ± 2 segments; train excludes target rows in that interval
preprocessing: same fit_ridge/fit_catboost, CORE_FEATURES, alpha=10, row-uniform weights, fixed CatBoost parameters; refit on old masks reproduces archive predictions to numerical precision
